notes.title: Legendary strategies are back!
notes.content:
[b]While media regularly share news about games disappearing from digital distribution, publishers like SNEG ensure that as many iconic titles as possible are easily accessible to players. The Warlords series and the five original Close Combat games, for the first time, are available on Steam. Generations of players grew up with these titles, and now access to them is easier than ever before.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14953/Close_Combat_Collection/]CLOSE COMBAT COLLECTION[/url]

Today, eight classics fully optimized to the requirements of modern computers and operating systems make their debut on Steam, while the first installment of the Close Combat series premieres in digital distribution as a separate and fully functional title. The publisher has also made every effort to eliminate technical issues, with changes based on fan and community feedback.
The Close Combat series immerses players into the time of World War II, where they will encounter challenges across various sides of the conflict. In these games players command troops in diverse historical campaigns, engaging in intense battles across a variety of terrains and scenarios. The first installment hit the market in 1996, surprising players with a combination of strategic gameplay, great graphics, animation, and sound effects. Fans of military strategy games fell in love with attention to detail, historical accuracy, and challenging gameplay, which made these games unique from other titles available at the time. Starting from today, players will once again be able to engage in battle in the five original games from this series developed by Atomic Games that started it all.

[list]
[*] Close Combat – defeat the enemy in this classic, nonstop World War II battle action. Lead your men through the terror, fatigue, and hell of war to victory. Only you can bring them back alive! For the first time in history, Close Combat is available digitally as a standalone, fully functional game.

[*] Close Combat 2: A Bridge Too Far – take control of five strategic bridges in the most dramatic battle of World War II. From war-room strategy to gritty trench combat, battlefields come to life as you command Allied or Axis powers. It's a fight where every second counts.

[*] Close Combat 3: The Russian Front – command a fire brigade of soldiers on the Russian Front in this real-time strategy game set in World War II. Play as either the Soviets or Germans, orchestrating squad attacks, defenses, and survival over four grueling years of the grandest and bloodiest war the world has ever seen.

[*] Close Combat 4: The Battle of the Bulge – sneak attacks, stalwart defenders, spies, and saboteurs are among the exciting surprises lurking on both sides of the battle. Whether you command American or German troops, you decide when and where they will be deployed. Launch air attacks against the enemy, but keep your eyes on the skies; random weather patterns can wreak havoc on your offensives from above.

[*] Close Combat 5: Invasion: Normandy - Utah Beach to Cherbourg – WWII realism is brought back to the beaches of Northern France. Relive the campaign that gave the Allies a foothold on the doorstep of Fortress Europe. From Utah Beach to Cherbourg, Invasion: Normandy gives you strategic and tactical control of Allied or Axis forces in the pivotal battles that determined the fate of Europe. 
[/list]

Players who prefer battles in fantasy worlds can immerse themselves in three games from the Warlords series, developed by Strategic Studies Group. The first installment of Warlords was released in 1990, setting trends for the entire genre, thanks to its depth of strategy, immersive world-building, and engaging gameplay mechanics. As media mentioned at that time, Warlords game has everything to offer the strategy gamer who has a taste for a bit of the fantasy genre. To experience these, players can now reach for:

[list]
[*] Warlords I + II – compilation of two great award-winning games. Both bring different worlds to conquer, mighty armies to fight, and enemies to vanquish. Brave heroes, quests, diplomacy and magic are all employed to overwhelm your rivals and dominate the world!

[*] Warlords III: Darklords Rising – Enter a rich fantasy world of medieval warfare teeming with rage, revenge and bravery. This epic game of strategy and conquest now delivers a vastly larger world and deeper strategic gameplay that expands beyond the scope and depth of the original Warlords III: Reign of Heroes. Five epic campaigns and massive strategic battles serve as proving grounds that challenge the mettle of even the greatest Heroes and Warlords.
[/list]

All of the above games are now available for purchase on Steam - separately for 5.99 USD each or in promotional bundles. During the launch week, players can look forward to some great deals with discounts up to almost 50%.
—
[b]About SNEG:[/b]

SNEG is a boutique publisher focused on reviving old gaming gems. We have an admiration for classics and a desire to bring back more interactive entertainment from all eras of the video gaming culture.

notes.title: Close Combat: Modern Tactics is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Back in 2004, Matrix Games proudly presented [b]Close Combat: Modern Tactics[/b]. A detailed, real-time war simulator based on an actual tool developed for and used by the United States Marine Corps. This fondly remembered classic still holds up today, thanks to its beautiful hand-drawn maps and the depth of the strategy available to players. 

The attention to detail has been bested by few since, which is [b]why we are now bringing it to Steam for the first time[/b]. This also completes the Close Combat collection for Steam users, who will[b] now have access to all of the Close Combat franchise in one place.[/b]

To celebrate this launch, we are including a substantial [b]40% discount[/b] on Close Combat: Modern Tactics on Steam. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367330/Close_Combat_Modern_Tactics/

We are also additionally having discounts on the various other Close Combat Series games.
Looking to complete your collection at a substantial discount? You can grab all the titles your missing, including Close Combat: Modern Tactics, in the complete collection: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14953/Close_Combat_Collection/

Note: Some discounts will not be available until after 6pm GMT (UK Time), if you do not find a discount on the Close Combat title you want, try refreshing the page after confirming it is 6pm GMT or later.

notes.title: Close Combat: The Bloody First is deployed
notes.content:
Following the German invasion of Poland, US forces started relocating their forces in preparation of possible operations in Europe.

As part of the partial mobilization, the 1st Infantry Division got more personnel and equipment, ready to be deployed for Operation Torch within the II Corps.

But Algeria and Tunisia were only the beginning. Soldiers previously unknown to each other became brothers, forged by the fire of dozens of battles.

After the fall of Tunisia was the turn of Sicily and then Normandy to get stormed.

The time to reverse the tide has come.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/811880/Close_Combat_The_Bloody_First/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019843/da844e7d0d066c2bbd12aecfc24ad2279dbbf54c.jpg[/img]

The Bloody First, the latest release in the critically-acclaimed Close Combat series, is out.

Take your chance to lead your men through a Grand Campaign covering three theatres, and watch them fight with tooth and nails against a variety of different enemies, from hardened veterans to kampfgruppen quickly gathered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019843/5f83f6117dc84f47c0708e292af342f9e543c722.jpg[/img]

The new 3D Archon Engine has expanded the level of detail of the battlefields, making every position on the map critical and important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019843/6aa5d19bf2d161643542a8714805f0f282afa824.jpg[/img]

Multiplayer has always been an acclaimed feature of the series and in The Bloody First this is truer than ever. Fight in bitter 1 vs 1 battles or team up in co-op against the AI to better coordinate your actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019843/85655c5661a99d9b4544c29cf4ffb465b8564e12.jpg[/img]

Do you want to see the game in action? Don’t miss our Twitch Stream today with DasTactic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35019843/6830ae4e716853b81871aef283af341fcf1095e0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Close Combat: Panthers in the Fog is out on Steam!
notes.content:
[i]“In spite of intense efforts, the moment has drawn near when this front, already so heavily strained, will break”[/i] ( Field Marshal Günther von Kluge)

On the evening of the 6th August 1944 Waffen SS and Whermacht troops attacked the fortified allied positions near the town of Mortain, in an attempt to cut through the American forces and reach the coast. However, the US high command knew Germans intentions thanks to the intercepts of Ultra and has prepared their positions...[b]Operation Luttich is about to begin![/b]

Since its first release [b]Close Combat: Panthers in the Fog[/b] has benefited from regular and in-depth support from the developers, and it is now ready for the [b]Steam platform[/b], reaching a whole new level by making this classic strategy title available to a whole new audience!
